name: Kinetics-400 Action Recognition Dataset
description: A premier large-scale benchmark for video action classification curated by Google DeepMind and hosted by the Computer Vision Development Foundation (CVDF). Consists of approximately 306,000 high-definition 10-second video clips sourced from YouTube, spanning 400 human action classes covering person-person, person-object, and person-only actions. Has served as the standard pretraining benchmark for 3D CNNs and video transformers.
